integrations.name: Make.com
integrations.description: Connect your Universal Links workspace to 2,000+ apps via Make.com.
integrations.readme:
This is the official Make.com integration for Universal Links. Make.com lets you connect Universal Links with thousands of the most popular apps in just a few clicks. Choose from thousands of ready-made apps or use our no-code toolkit to connect to apps.

## Features

The following modules are supported.
- Create a link
- Update a link
- Retrieve a link
- Upsert a link
- Delete a link
- Make an API Call

## How to install
1. Click on "Enable"
2. Allow Make.com to access your Universal Links workspace
3. Now, you can use Universal Links modules in Make.com to create visual automated workflows.

integrations.name: Zapier
integrations.description: Connect your Universal Links workspace to 7,000+ apps via Zapier.
integrations.readme:
This is the official Zapier integration for Universal Links. It's easy to implement, does not require coding, and allows you to connect Universal Links with other apps in minutes.

## Supported actions

**Universal Links Links**:
- [Create link](https://universallinks.co/docs/api-reference/endpoint/create-a-link)
- [Retrieve link](https://universallinks.co/docs/api-reference/endpoint/retrieve-a-link)
- [Update link](https://universallinks.co/docs/api-reference/endpoint/update-a-link)
- [Upsert link](https://universallinks.co/docs/api-reference/endpoint/upsert-a-link)
- [Delete link](https://universallinks.co/docs/api-reference/endpoint/delete-a-link)

**Universal Links Conversions**:
- [Track a lead event](https://universallinks.co/docs/api-reference/endpoint/track-lead)
- [Track a sale event](https://universallinks.co/docs/api-reference/endpoint/track-sale)

## Supported triggers

**Universal Links Links**
- `link.created`
- `link.updated`
- `link.deleted`
- `link.clicked`

**Universal Links Conversions**
- `lead.created`
- `sale.created`

integrations.name: Cal.com
integrations.description: Track how your links are converting to meeting bookings on Cal.com.
integrations.readme:
Integrate with Cal.com to automatically track [lead conversion events](https://universallinks.co/docs/conversions/leads/introduction) when someone books a meeting via one of your Universal Links short links.

Useful for tracking SaaS enterprise leads or agency meeting bookings.

## Installation steps

1. Click on "Enable" to install the Universal Links app in the Cal.com App Store.
2. Set up the [`@universallinks/analytics` client-side script](https://universallinks.co/docs/sdks/client-side/introduction) on your site, and add both `app.cal.com` and `cal.com` to your [outbound domains](https://universallinks.co/docs/sdks/client-side/features/cross-domain-tracking).
3. Once a booking event occurs, the booker's details will automatically be tracked as a [lead event](https://universallinks.co/docs/conversions/leads/introduction) on Universal Links.

## Example App

Check out this [open-source example](https://github.com/yashhasan570/examples/blob/main/conversions/cal) to learn more about how to integrate Cal.com and Universal Links to track meeting booking events.

integrations.name: Hubspot
integrations.description: Track Hubspot leads/deal changes as conversions on Universal Links.
integrations.readme:
Easily track and attribute leads and sales from HubSpot inside Universal Links.

## Features

- Bidirectional sync between HubSpot contacts and Universal Links lead events
- Automatic attribution of leads to the exact Universal Links link
- Support for HubSpot Forms and HubSpot Meeting Scheduler
- Closed Won sale tracking

## Setup process

1. Enable conversion tracking in Universal Links
2. Install the `@universallinks/analytics` script on your site
3. Connect HubSpot via the Universal Links integration
4. (Optional) Set your custom **Closed Won Deal Stage ID**

Once connected, Universal Links gives you full visibility into your funnel — from click → lead → meeting → Closed Won revenue.

integrations.name: Publer
integrations.description: Automatically shorten every social link on Publer with Universal Links.
integrations.readme:
**[Publer](https://publer.com)** is a social media management platform that empowers creators to schedule and publish posts across all major social networks. Through the **Universal Links** integration, you can automatically shorten every link you share via Publer—keeping your posts clean and engaging.

**Key Benefits**:

- **Automatic Link Shortening:** No extra steps are needed. Publer will shorten all your links in real time.  
- **Better Post Aesthetics:** Shorter links mean cleaner posts, reducing clutter and making your content more reader-friendly.  
- **Analytics & Insights:** Universal Links provides click tracking and analytics, allowing you to measure engagement and refine your social media strategy.

**Getting Started:**
1. Connect your Universal Links account in Publer’s social account settings.
2. Schedule your social media posts as usual.  
3. Sit back and let Publer automatically shorten all your links with Universal Links!
